description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for handling report-related operations, including listing available export formats and executing reports with various parameters. It is a part of the Fineract project and uses JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, along with Swagger for API documentation.

classes.name: RunreportsApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints to retrieve available export formats and to execute reports with various parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllAvailableExports
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all available export types for a specified report, considering whether it is a self-service user report.

methods.name: runReport
methods.description: Handles GET requests to execute a report, supporting multiple output formats and filtering parameters.

methods.name: processReportRequest
methods.description: Internal method to process the report execution logic, checks permissions, determines report type, and delegates to the appropriate reporting service.

methods.name: checkUserPermissionForReport
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to run the specified report unless only parameter values are requested.
